# Version 4.151.1
> **Chrome M151 servicing fixes** · Released August 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.1/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.1 brings seven Chrome M151 servicing fixes to the bundled Skia engine. The update addresses Ganesh flush failures and stale readbacks, improves Imagination GPU compatibility, and corrects Fontations bitmap-strike selection.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Chrome M151 fixes integrated** — Updates the bundled engine with fixes for Ganesh flush failures and stale readbacks, an Imagination FBO driver workaround, Fontations bitmap-strike selection, and SkSL map-pointer handling. ([#4667](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4667))

Updates the co-shipped HarfBuzzSharp package from 14.2.1 to 14.2.1.1.
